title: Article 347 — Special provision relating to language spoken by a section of the population of a State

content.overview: Article 347 provides that on a demand being made in that behalf, the President may, if he is satisfied that a substantial proportion of the population of a State desire the use of any language spoken by them to be recognised by that State, direct that such language shall also be officially recognised throughout that State or any part thereof for such purpose as he may specify.
content.glance: President may direct official recognition of a language spoken by a substantial proportion of a State’s population, throughout the State or in part, for specified purposes.
content.study:
Article 347 special recognition:
- Trigger: demand; President satisfied that a substantial proportion of the population desires recognition of their language.
- Effect: direction that the language be officially recognised throughout the State or any part, for purposes specified by the President.

Examination: substantial proportion; Presidential direction; whole or part of State; specified purposes.

sections.heading: Key rule
sections.body: On demand, if satisfied that a substantial proportion of the population desires it, the President may direct official recognition of their language throughout the State or any part, for specified purposes.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 347 provide?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 347 provides that on a demand being made in that behalf, the President may, if he is satisfied that a substantial proportion of the population of a State desire the use of any language spoken by them to be recognised by that State, direct that such language shall also be officially recognised throughout that State or any part thereof for such purpose as he may specify.

examTips: Presidential recognition of minority language in a State; substantial proportion test.

keyTakeaways: Art 347: special official recognition of a language spoken by a section of a State’s population.
